_comment: AOT images of what the app's users run most: Java and Maven (libjvm.so), Kimi Code (node),
Claude Code (claude.exe, Bun) and musl under all of them. Recorded by record_app_images.sh on
the root the app ships, with the packages below at the versions apk and npm give that day: an
image serves the module it was recorded from (its ELF build-id), so record again after the
app's root or those packages change (Claude Code updates itself often). node is recorded in
the mode the app runs it in with its image, the interpreter (guest/kimi/kimi_train.sh).
